nodes.label: ModernResumePreview Component
nodes.rationale: Pure presentation component with exact A4 measurements, memoized for efficiency. Being pure and measurement-exact is what allows the same component to serve both the live preview and the Puppeteer-rendered PDF, guaranteeing they match.

nodes.label: ModernResumeEditor Component
nodes.rationale: Split-screen editor owning section editing, auto-save and state management; renders ModernResumePreview in the right panel.

nodes.label: Resume Preview Page (/resume/preview/[id])
nodes.rationale: Chrome-less page that renders the resume for Puppeteer to capture, accepting auth tokens for server-side rendering and signalling window.resumeReady when content and fonts are loaded.

nodes.label: Resume Builder PDF Generation Service
nodes.rationale: backend/src/resume-builder/resume-builder.service.ts drives Puppeteer to the preview page at a 1588x2246 viewport then prints A4 at scale 0.5 with printBackground and zero margins. The 2x viewport scaled down yields retina-sharp text; waiting on window.resumeReady plus a 1s font-render delay prevents capturing an unstyled page. PDF generation is inherently server-side only.

nodes.label: Pixel-Perfect PDF Matching Principle
nodes.rationale: The downloaded PDF must equal the on-screen preview exactly (WYSIWYG). Achieved by rendering the PDF from the same React preview component via a real browser (Puppeteer) rather than a separate PDF-drawing code path, which is what caused preview/PDF divergence in the old editor.

nodes.label: Debounced Auto-Save
nodes.rationale: Changes persist after 1s of inactivity; debouncing prevents an API call per keystroke while keeping work safe without an explicit save action.

nodes.label: Resume Template Design System
nodes.rationale: Customization axes: 6 color schemes (Blue/Green/Purple/Orange/Red/Indigo, each with primary/secondary/accent/dark/light variants), 3 font sizes, 3 spacing modes (Compact 1.4 / Normal 1.6 / Relaxed 1.8 line height) and 5 font families (Inter, Roboto, Playfair, Lato, Montserrat). Constraining to preset combinations keeps output professional and PDF-reproducible.

nodes.label: Resume AI Content Tools
nodes.rationale: Per-section Generate / Rewrite / Enhance actions covering summary generation, section regeneration, experience achievement bullets and skills extraction, exposed through /api/resume-builder/:id/regenerate-section.

nodes.label: FlowCV Design Inspiration
nodes.rationale: Design cites FlowCV (flowcv.com) for the split-screen editing model, plus Notion's clean interface, Linear's attention to detail, and Tailwind UI / Catalyst design systems.

nodes.label: Resume Builder Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
nodes.rationale: Targets WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard navigation, ARIA labels on interactive elements, sufficient contrast, screen-reader friendliness, visible focus indicators, proper heading hierarchy and image alt text.

nodes.label: Resume Builder Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Planned: real-time collaboration, version history, live ATS score, template marketplace, multi-page resumes, Word/LaTeX/HTML export, custom sections, drag-and-drop reordering; plus dark mode and mobile touch optimization.
